media.description: Illustrierter Film-Kurier cover for the film Seitensprünge (1931), directed by István Székely; a European-period film with music by Bronisław Kaper (Film F006).
media.altText: Illustrated Film-Kurier cover for Seitensprünge, showing film-promotion artwork and issue text.
media.rightsNote: Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 229 (Berlin, 1931). Reviewed 2026-07-05: no individual cover designer credited. Anonymous German work, published 1931 → PD ~2002 (§66 UrhG, 70 yrs); underlying photo PD as Lichtbild (50 yrs); reproductions of PD 2-D works stay PD (EU DSM Art. 14). Rights upgraded fair-use → OK (public domain). Assumes no designer later identified; not legal advice. Credit: 'Illustrierter Film-Kurier, no. 229 (public domain)'.
